title: State fusion transformer
purpose: Develop the state fusion transformer. The owner identified this family as of great importance.
boundary: This Hero owns the state fusion transformer in code/fusion/state_fusion_transformer. The model is a Set Transformer with induced set attention and pooling by multihead attention. It encodes an unordered set of records into a fixed market state. Hx11 owns latent-dynamics operations. Hx20 owns the Temporal Fusion Transformer in code/fusion. The State Representation Network maps one observation embedding to a predictive state and is not this family. This family has no temporal feature. A result here does not close Hx11 or Hx20.
summary: On 29 October 2026 the family was placed in code/fusion/state_fusion_transformer and given a CUDA Set Transformer. Induced set attention and one-seed pooling encode an unordered set. A GPU test checked permutation invariance, hole gating, and key padding. On one fixed synthetic panel, 400 Adam steps reduced masked error from 1.25887 to 1.85048e-06. The panels are pipeline validation. No pretrained weights are used.

goals.title: Encode an unordered set into a market state
goals.description: Fuse records with explicit holes into one fixed state tensor. The recorded scope is the CUDA encoder and the synthetic pipeline check.

milestones.title: Run the Set Transformer on CUDA
milestones.description: On 29 October 2026, inside the managed container, make test compiled the package with g++ against /opt/cuwacunu_embedding/libtorch 2.6.0 and CUDA toolkit 12.4 on an NVIDIA RTX A2000. state_fusion_invariance passed on cuda:0: permutation_max_abs=3.57628e-07, hole_max_abs=0, nan_hole_max_abs=0, unobserved_record_max_abs=0, padding_max_abs=4.76837e-07, two_seed_permutation_max_abs=7.15256e-07, observed_zero_gap=0.0210351. state_fusion_train then ran 400 Adam steps on one fixed synthetic panel and printed initial_masked_mse=1.25887 and final_masked_mse=1.85048e-06. That error is pipeline validation, not a market result. Products are under /opt/mityane-geometrics/fusion/build/state-fusion-transformer. The image has no cmake binary. CMakeLists.txt is the build description, and the Makefile is the entry that ran.
acceptance: The package builds against the LibTorch 2.6.0 CUDA build, and the attention and training path run on CUDA.
A GPU test passes permutation invariance, shows that editing a hole leaves the state unchanged, and shows that an observed zero is distinct from a hole.
The training executable runs masked reconstruction on one fixed synthetic panel on CUDA, and the final masked error is finite and below half the initial error.
The weights are initialized here. The package does not load pretrained weights and does not depend on Nonverba.
